mapper.select: SELECT r.ROOM_ID, r.ROOM_NAME, r.CREATE_DATE FROM CHAT_ROOMS r JOIN CHAT_MEMBERS m ON r.ROOM_ID = m.ROOM_ID WHERE m.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ROOM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOMS (ROOM_ID, ROOM_NAME, CREATE_DATE) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{roomName}, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO CHAT_MEMBERS (MEMBER_ID, ROOM_ID, USER_ID) VALUES (SEQ_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT m.CR_MSG_ID, m.ROOM_ID, m.SENDER_ID, u.USER_NAME as senderName, m.CONTENT, m.SEND_DATE FROM CHAT_MSGS m JOIN USERS u ON m.SENDER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE m.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY m.SEND_DATE ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MSGS (CR_MSG_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT, SEND_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_MSG_ID.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
